product.title: Plaud Note Pro
product.description: Plaud Note Pro is a slim card-sized hardware recorder with a dark grey ribbed metal body, black top band, visible logo placement, compact proportions, and a premium desk-ready form factor designed to sit beside a phone or notebook.
